name: trauma
description: A strong negative experience from the perception that a recent event changed your world for the worse.
perceptions: A very bad thing happened to me or someone close.
examples: Being the victim of a violent crime.

guidance.description: Real trauma is no joke. Consider learning more and perhaps seeking help.

If a parent or romantic partner violates your trust, you may experience betrayal trauma. This trauma may affect your self-esteem, emotional health, and relationships with others, but support can help you heal.

variations.name: post-traumatic stress disorder
variations.description: A strong negative experience from the memories of a long-ago event that changed your world for the worse.
perceptions: A very bad thing happened to me or someone close.
The event was a long time ago.
I'm still overwhelmed with negative emotions.

guidance.description: PTSD can seriously decrease the quality of your life. Please consider learning about it and seeking help.

variations.name: victim of crime
variations.description: A strong negative experience from another person having harmed you physically or socially in an unfairly aggressive way.
perceptions: A very bad thing happened to me or someone close.
It was caused by another person's aggressive greed or selfishness.
I think there should be justice.

guidance.description: Being a victim of crime can destroy your sense of safety and control. If you're struggling to cope, consider seeking help.

commentaries.quote: Trauma is when a negative sensation takes over your life, whether it's grief, fear, betrayal, horror, shame, or something else.
Trauma creates change you don't choose. Healing is about creating change you do choose.

Even if you've accumulated a house full of nice things and the picture of your life fits inside a beautiful frame, if you have experienced trauma but haven't excavated it, the wounded parts of you will affect everything you've managed to build.
To live in the body of a survivor is to never be able to leave the scene of the crime. I cannot ignore the fact that I live here.
There are wounds that never show on the body that are deeper and more hurtful than anything that bleeds.

Rape is one of the most terrible crimes on earth and it happens every few minutes. The problem with groups who deal with rape is that they try to educate women about how to defend themselves. What really needs to be done is teaching men not to rape. Go to the source and start there.
